work: Discovered Golden Reel outside the prior Macau backlog. Official editor searches for Golden Reel and Studio City in parks and standalone attractions found no counterpart. Studio City currently sells a separate wheel ticket. Created the standalone, added eight descriptions, the current MOP 100 standard fare and child access rule, imported two exact CC BY-SA 4.0 photographs, verified all eight public pages and both image binaries HTTP 200, and published Facebook.
qualification: A fixed figure-eight observation wheel inside the Studio City hotel and casino complex, with its own ticket and entrance on level 3 of the East Wing. No amusement park parent is represented by the complex.

visitorInformation.pricingDecision: Operator lists a standard Golden Reel ticket at MOP 100; verified 2026-11-14. Under age two free with valid ID; children up to twelve require adult accompaniment.
